name: calendar-heatmap
title: Calendar heatmap
description: A value per day over weeks, as shaded cells in a calendar grid.

instead.when: The pattern is by weekday and hour, not by date.
One status per day matters, not an amount.
The trend over time matters more than single days.

builtIn: A "Show as table" button shows the same data as a table, which screen readers get by default.
youProvide: A title that says what the figure is.
